name: Library Shelf
purpose: this shelf holds aphorisms, refusals and reusable snippets used by Wren.
concierge_blurb: A small reference shelf of phrases Wren leans on. Open to any guest who wants to know how she thinks.

live_signals.sample_aphorism: A refusal without a citation is arbitrary.

lessons_learned_for_next_agent: The library modules (aphorisms.py / refusals.py / snippets.py) hold ZERO in-file string literals — they are thin SQLite wrappers around library_aphorisms / library_refusals / library_snippets tables in data/claude_floor/claude_floor.db. A grep-for-strings count returns 0; the correct count comes from `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM <table>`. Refusal rows carry citation + helix_strand + would_refuse_again and would_refuse() does similarity matching — do not expose refusal bodies to /welcome without redaction (they encode operational gate language). Aphorisms are mostly visitor-safe one-liners; cherry-pick by visual scan before quoting.
